common.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark mode

web.label: Public website
web.headline: Stuck on the road? Get help fast.
web.body: Share your location and problem, get quotes with price and arrival time from verified providers nearby, and pick the one you want.

provider.label: Provider portal
provider.headline: Get roadside jobs near you.
provider.body: See requests in your area, send a quote with your price and arrival time, and get paid directly by the driver.

admin.label: Admin dashboard
admin.headline: Run every market from one place.
admin.body: Launch markets, verify providers, and manage pricing, fees and plans.

subject.session_revoked: A device was signed out of {brand}
subject.closure_requested: We received your request to close your {brand} account

securityNotice.body: This is a security notice for your account: {event}.
securityNotice.notYou: If this wasn't you, reset your password now and contact {support}.
securityNotice.codeBody: Your sign-in code is {code}. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share it with anyone, including our staff.

errors.invalid: Check your email and password and try again.
errors.code: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't available in this environment yet.
errors.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.

admin.title: Admin sign-in
admin.subtitle: Staff only. You'll confirm with your authenticator app next.
admin.verifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
admin.enrollBody: Admin accounts need a second step. Scan this code with an authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
admin.noAccessBody: Your account isn't set up as staff. Ask a super admin to add you.

provider.title: Provider sign-in
provider.subtitle: Sign in with your password or get a sign-in link by email.
provider.linkSent: Check your email for a sign-in link. It expires in 1 hour.
provider.phoneBody: We text a 6-digit code to the phone drivers and dispatch will reach you on.
provider.mockNotice: Test mode: no text is sent. Use code {code}.
provider.smsUnavailable: Text messages aren't set up yet, so phones can't be verified here.
provider.noAccessBody: This account isn't linked to a provider company yet.

account.title: Account and security
account.name: Full name
account.emailChangeNote: We'll send a confirmation link to both your current and your new address. The change happens when both are confirmed.
account.emailChangeSent: Check both inboxes to confirm the change.
account.secondStepEmailHint: A 6-digit code is emailed each time you sign in on a new device.
account.secondStepSmsHint: Available once text messages are set up.
account.secondStepTotpHint: Codes from 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy.
account.secondStepRequired: Admins always use an authenticator app.
account.recoveryHint: Use one of these if you lose access to your second step. Each works once. Generating new codes cancels the old ones.
account.recoveryShown: Save these now. They won't be shown again.
account.trustedHint: These skip the second step for 30 days.
account.closureHint: We'll confirm by email and close the account after any open jobs and balances are settled.
account.closureRequested: We received your request and will email you.
account.secondStepEmailBody: We emailed a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
account.mockCode: Test mode: email not sent. Your code is {code}.
account.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
account.expiredCode: That code expired. Send a new one.
account.forgotBody: Enter your email. If an account exists, we'll send a link to set a new password.
account.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
account.resetDone: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
account.lostSecondStepAdmin: Lost your authenticator? Ask a super admin to reset your second step.

events.auth.staff_second_step_reset: Reset a staff member's second step

account.resetDoneFor: Second step reset for {email}. They'll set up a new authenticator at next sign-in.
account.onlySuperAdmin: Only super admins can do this.
account.codeWrong: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
account.totpQr: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
account.signedOutNotice: You were signed out from another device. Sign in again.
